# Built-in actions

<!-- Generated by `osb docs -o docs/reference`. Do not edit. -->

Types: `string`, `text` (multi-line string), `bool`, `int`, `list` (list of strings; a single string is accepted),

## Files

### copy-files

Copy local files, directories or glob matches to the target. Directories are copied recursively; a destination ending in / receives files by name.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes |  | Local file, directory or glob, relative to the configuration file |
| `dest` | string | yes |  | Absolute destination (directory if it ends with / or the source is a directory/glob) |
| `mode` | mode |  |  | Mode for files (default: keep the local mode) |
| `dir-mode` | mode |  | `0755` | Mode for created directories |
| `owner` | string |  |  | Owner (user name or uid) |
| `group` | string |  |  | Group (group name or gid) |

```yaml
- action: copy-files
  args:
    source: files/etc/
    dest: /etc/
```

### delete-file

Delete files or directories.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | list | yes |  | Absolute path(s) |
| `recursive` | bool |  | `false` | Delete directories recursively |

```yaml
- action: delete-file
  args:
    path: [/etc/motd, /etc/update-motd.d/10-help-text]
```

### download-file

Download a URL to a file, optionally verifying its SHA-256 checksum. Rendered as ADD in Dockerfiles.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes |  | URL |
| `path` | string | yes |  | Absolute destination path |
| `sha256` | string |  |  | Expected SHA-256 checksum (hex) |
| `mode` | mode |  | `0644` | File mode |
| `owner` | string |  |  | Owner (user name or uid) |
| `group` | string |  |  | Group (group name or gid) |

```yaml
- action: download-file
  args:
    url: https://example.com/tool
    path: /usr/local/bin/tool
    mode: "0755"
```

### extract-archive

Extract a tar (optionally compressed) or zip archive that exists on the target.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Archive on the target |
| `dest` | string | yes |  | Destination directory (created) |
| `strip-components` | int |  | `0` | Strip leading path components (tar only) |
| `owner` | string |  |  | Owner (user name or uid) |
| `group` | string |  |  | Group (group name or gid) |

```yaml
- action: extract-archive
  args:
    path: /tmp/tool.tar.gz
    dest: /opt/tool
    strip-components: 1
```

### git-clone

Clone a git repository, or fetch and check out the ref if it already exists.

Installs when missing: `git`, `ca-certificates`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `repo` | string | yes |  | Repository URL |
| `dest` | string | yes |  | Destination directory |
| `ref` | string |  |  | Branch, tag or commit to check out |
| `user` | string |  |  | Clone as this user |
| `depth` | int |  |  | Shallow clone depth (0 = full) |

```yaml
- action: git-clone
  args:
    repo: https://github.com/example/dotfiles.git
    dest: /home/alice/.dotfiles
    user: alice
```

### line-in-file

Ensure a line is present in a file (replacing the first line matching regex), or remove lines matching regex.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Absolute path |
| `line` | string |  |  | The line (required for state present) |
| `regex` | string |  |  | Extended regular expression selecting the line to replace or remove |
| `state` | string |  | `present` | present or absent One of: `present`, `absent`. |

```yaml
- action: line-in-file
  args:
    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    regex: '^#?PermitRootLogin'
    line: PermitRootLogin no
```

### mkdir

Create directories (including parents).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | list | yes |  | Absolute path(s) |
| `mode` | mode |  | `0755` | Directory mode |
| `owner` | string |  |  | Owner (user name or uid) |
| `group` | string |  |  | Group (group name or gid) |

```yaml
- action: mkdir
  args:
    path: /srv/app
    owner: app
```

### replace-in-file

Replace all matches of an extended regular expression (sed -E syntax) in a file. Use \1 for groups in the replacement.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Absolute path |
| `regex` | string | yes |  | POSIX extended regular expression |
| `replace` | string | yes |  | Replacement |

```yaml
- action: replace-in-file
  args:
    path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
    regex: '^#?PasswordAuthentication.*'
    replace: PasswordAuthentication no
```

### set-config-value

Set a value in a structured configuration file. json uses jq, yaml uses yq (both installed when missing), ini and env need no extra tools. The key is a dot separated path for json/yaml.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Absolute path of the file (created when missing) |
| `format` | string | yes |  | File format One of: `json`, `yaml`, `ini`, `env`. |
| `key` | string | yes |  | Key; dot separated path for json and yaml (a.b.0.c) |
| `value` | any | yes |  | Value; any YAML value for json and yaml |
| `section` | string |  |  | INI section (empty for the top level) |

```yaml
- action: set-config-value
  args:
    path: /etc/docker/daemon.json
    format: json
    key: log-driver
    value: journald
```

### set-permissions

Change mode and/or ownership of existing paths.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | list | yes |  | Absolute path(s) |
| `mode` | string |  |  | Mode, octal (0750) or symbolic (u+x) |
| `recursive` | bool |  | `false` | Apply recursively |
| `owner` | string |  |  | Owner (user name or uid) |
| `group` | string |  |  | Group (group name or gid) |

```yaml
- action: set-permissions
  args:
    path: /srv/app
    owner: app
    group: app
    recursive: true
```

### symlink

Create a symbolic link.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Absolute path of the link |
| `target` | string | yes |  | Link target |

```yaml
- action: symlink
  args:
    path: /usr/local/bin/python
    target: /usr/bin/python3
```

### template-file

Render a local file containing ${{ }} expressions and write it to the target.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Absolute destination path |
| `source` | string | yes |  | Template file, relative to the configuration file |
| `mode` | mode |  | `0644` | File mode |
| `owner` | string |  |  | Owner (user name or uid) |
| `group` | string |  |  | Group (group name or gid) |

```yaml
- action: template-file
  args:
    path: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/app.conf
    source: templates/app.conf
```

### write-file

Write a file with inline content or the content of a local file. Rendered natively as COPY (Dockerfile) and write_files (cloud-init).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | Absolute destination path |
| `content` | text |  |  | File content |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local file, relative to the configuration file |
| `mode` | mode |  | `0644` | File mode |
| `append` | bool |  | `false` | Append the content unless it is already present |
| `owner` | string |  |  | Owner (user name or uid) |
| `group` | string |  |  | Group (group name or gid) |

```yaml
- action: write-file
  args:
    path: /etc/motd
    content: |
      Welcome!
```

## Commands

### run-command

Run a command. By default it is executed directly (no shell): a string is split into words, a list is used as is. With shell: true the string is run by /bin/sh.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | any | yes |  | Command line (string) or argv (list) |
| `shell` | bool |  | `false` | Run the command with /bin/sh -c |
| `user` | string |  |  | Run as this user |
| `dir` | string |  |  | Working directory |
| `env` | map |  |  | Environment variables |

```yaml
- action: run-command
  args:
    command: [systemctl, set-default, multi-user.target]
```

### run-script

Run an inline script or a local script file with an interpreter. A /bin/sh script without user, dir and env is inlined into the generated output.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | text |  |  | Inline script |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local script file, relative to the configuration file |
| `interpreter` | string |  | `/bin/sh` | Interpreter, e.g. /bin/bash or /usr/bin/python3 |
| `args` | list |  |  | Arguments passed to the script |
| `user` | string |  |  | Run as this user |
| `dir` | string |  |  | Working directory |
| `env` | map |  |  | Environment variables |

```yaml
- action: run-script
  args:
    script: |
      for i in 1 2 3; do echo "$i"; done
```

## Users

### add-group

Create a group if it does not exist.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Group name |
| `gid` | string |  |  | Numeric group id |
| `system` | bool |  | `false` | Create a system group |

```yaml
- action: add-group
  args:
    name: developers
```

### add-user

Create a user (if missing) and add it to groups. Rendered natively as cloud-init users when possible.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | User name |
| `uid` | string |  |  | Numeric user id |
| `groups` | list |  |  | Supplementary groups (created when missing) |
| `shell` | string |  |  | Login shell, e.g. /bin/bash |
| `home` | string |  |  | Home directory |
| `comment` | string |  |  | Full name / GECOS |
| `system` | bool |  | `false` | Create a system account |
| `create-home` | bool |  | `true` | Create the home directory |
| `sudo` | bool |  | `false` | Grant sudo rights (sudo group on Debian/Ubuntu, wheel on Arch) |

```yaml
- action: add-user
  args:
    name: alice
    shell: /bin/bash
    groups: [docker]
    sudo: true
```

### add-user-to-group

Add an existing user to groups (groups are created when missing).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | string | yes |  | User name |
| `groups` | list | yes |  | Groups |

```yaml
- action: add-user-to-group
  args:
    user: alice
    groups: [docker, video]
```

### authorize-ssh-key

Add SSH public keys to a user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | string | yes |  | User name |
| `key` | list |  |  | Public key(s) |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local file with public keys, relative to the configuration file |

```yaml
- action: authorize-ssh-key
  args:
    user: alice
    source: keys/alice.pub
```

### remove-user

Remove a user if it exists.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | User name |
| `remove-home` | bool |  | `false` | Also remove the home directory and mail spool |

```yaml
- action: remove-user
  args:
    name: ubuntu
    remove-home: true
```

### set-password

Set a user's password from a (secret) value, a crypt hash, or a random password that is printed. For images a random password is generated once at build time.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | string | yes |  | User name |
| `password` | string |  |  | Plain text password (use a secret argument) |
| `hash` | string |  |  | Password hash as produced by mkpasswd/openssl passwd |
| `random` | bool |  | `false` | Generate a random password and print it |
| `length` | int |  | `20` | Length of a random password |
| `expire` | bool |  | `false` | Force a password change at first login |

```yaml
- action: set-password
  args:
    user: alice
    random: true
```

## Packages

### add-repository

Add a package repository. Takes flavor-specific settings: `apt` for Debian/Ubuntu (deb822 .sources file), `pacman` for Arch. Package lists are refreshed afterwards.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Repository name (file name / pacman section) |
| `apt` | any |  |  | apt settings: uri (required), suites (default: the release codename), components (default: main), key (armored key), key-url, architectures |
| `pacman` | any |  |  | pacman settings: server (required), sig-level, key-id, keyserver |

```yaml
- action: add-repository
  args:
    name: docker
    apt:
      uri: https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu
      components: stable
      key-url: https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg
```

### hold-packages

Prevent packages from being upgraded (apt-mark hold / pacman IgnorePkg).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list | yes |  | Package names |

```yaml
- action: hold-packages
  args:
    packages: [linux-image-generic]
```

### install-package-file

Install a package file (.deb / .pkg.tar.zst) that is on the target or copied from a local file.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  |  | Package file on the target |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local package file, copied to /var/cache/osb first |

```yaml
- action: install-package-file
  args:
    source: packages/tool_1.0_amd64.deb
```

### install-packages

Install packages from the distribution repositories. Generic names are mapped to flavor-specific names (e.g. build-essential -> base-devel on Arch). Rendered natively as cloud-init packages when possible.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list |  |  | Package names |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local package list file (# comments allowed) |

```yaml
- action: install-packages
  args:
    packages: [curl, git, vim]
```

### remove-packages

Remove (purge) packages.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `packages` | list |  |  | Package names |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local package list file |

```yaml
- action: remove-packages
  args:
    packages: [snapd]
```

### upgrade-system

Upgrade all installed packages.

```yaml
- action: upgrade-system
```

## System

### add-mount

Add a file system to /etc/fstab and mount it on live systems.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | string | yes |  | Device, UUID=..., LABEL=... or remote path |
| `path` | string | yes |  | Mount point |
| `fstype` | string | yes |  | File system type |
| `options` | string |  | `defaults` | Mount options |
| `dump` | int |  | `0` | dump field |
| `pass` | int |  | `0` | fsck pass number |
| `mount` | bool |  | `true` | Mount immediately on live systems |

```yaml
- action: add-mount
  args:
    device: LABEL=data
    path: /data
    fstype: ext4
```

### add-sudoers

Add a sudoers drop-in file in /etc/sudoers.d; it is validated with visudo when available.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | File name |
| `content` | text |  |  | sudoers content |
| `rules` | list |  |  | sudoers lines |

```yaml
- action: add-sudoers
  args:
    name: alice
    rules: ["alice ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL"]
```

### add-swap-file

Create and enable a swap file. Skipped for container targets.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | `/swapfile` | Swap file path |
| `size` | string | yes |  | Size, e.g. 2G or 512M |

```yaml
- action: add-swap-file
  args:
    size: 2G
```

### load-kernel-module

Load kernel modules at boot (/etc/modules-load.d) and immediately on live systems.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `modules` | list | yes |  | Module names |
| `name` | string |  | `osb` | File name: /etc/modules-load.d/<name>.conf |

```yaml
- action: load-kernel-module
  args:
    modules: [br_netfilter, overlay]
```

### set-environment

Set system-wide environment variables in /etc/environment (and ENV in Dockerfiles).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vars` | map | yes |  | Variable to value |

```yaml
- action: set-environment
  args:
    vars:
      EDITOR: vim
```

### set-hostname

Set the host name. Skipped for container targets (set at run time). Rendered natively in cloud-init.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hostname` | string | yes |  | Host name |

```yaml
- action: set-hostname
  args:
    hostname: devbox
```

### set-locale

Generate a locale and make it the system default (LANG).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `locale` | string | yes |  | Locale, e.g. en_US.UTF-8 |
| `charset` | string |  | `UTF-8` | Character set used in locale.gen |

```yaml
- action: set-locale
  args:
    locale: de_DE.UTF-8
```

### set-timezone

Set the system time zone.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timezone` | string | yes |  | IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin |

```yaml
- action: set-timezone
  args:
    timezone: Europe/Berlin
```

### sysctl

Persist kernel parameters in /etc/sysctl.d and apply them on live systems.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `settings` | map | yes |  | Parameter to value |
| `name` | string |  | `osb` | File name: /etc/sysctl.d/90-<name>.conf |

```yaml
- action: sysctl
  args:
    settings:
      net.ipv4.ip_forward: 1
```

### trust-ca

Add a CA certificate (PEM) to the system trust store (update-ca-certificates / update-ca-trust).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Certificate name (file name without extension) |
| `content` | text |  |  | PEM certificate |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local PEM file |
| `url` | string |  |  | Download the certificate from this URL |

```yaml
- action: trust-ca
  args:
    name: corp-root
    source: certs/corp-root.pem
```

## Systemd

### add-systemd-drop-in

Add a drop-in override (/etc/systemd/system/<unit>.d/<name>.conf).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | string | yes |  | Unit to override |
| `name` | string |  | `osb` | Drop-in name |
| `content` | text |  |  | Drop-in content |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local drop-in file |
| `restart` | bool |  | `false` | Restart the unit on live systems |

```yaml
- action: add-systemd-drop-in
  args:
    unit: getty@tty1.service
    name: autologin
    content: |
      [Service]
      ExecStart=
      ExecStart=-/sbin/agetty --autologin alice --noclear %I $TERM
```

### add-systemd-unit

Install a systemd unit file in /etc/systemd/system and enable it (default).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Unit name including suffix, e.g. app.service |
| `content` | text |  |  | Unit file content |
| `source` | string |  |  | Local unit file |
| `enable` | bool |  | `true` | Enable the unit |
| `start` | bool |  | `false` | (Re)start the unit on live systems |

```yaml
- action: add-systemd-unit
  args:
    name: hello.service
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Hello
      [Service]
      ExecStart=/bin/echo hello
      [Install]
      WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

### disable-systemd-unit

Disable (and optionally mask or stop) systemd units.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `units` | list | yes |  | Unit names |
| `mask` | bool |  | `false` | Mask the units |
| `now` | bool |  | `false` | Also stop the units on live systems |

```yaml
- action: disable-systemd-unit
  args:
    units: [apt-daily.timer]
    mask: true
```

### enable-systemd-unit

Enable systemd units; optionally start them on live systems.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `units` | list | yes |  | Unit names |
| `now` | bool |  | `false` | Also start the units on live systems |

```yaml
- action: enable-systemd-unit
  args:
    units: [ssh.service]
    now: true
```

### restart-systemd-unit

Restart systemd units on live systems (no-op for images).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `units` | list | yes |  | Unit names |

```yaml
- action: restart-systemd-unit
  args:
    units: [ssh.service]
```

## Control

### assert

Fail unless a condition holds: `that` is checked at generation time (use ${{ }}), `command` at run time.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `that` | bool |  |  | Generation-time condition |
| `command` | string |  |  | Run-time shell condition |
| `message` | string |  | `assertion failed` | Error message |

```yaml
- action: assert
  args:
    command: test -d /home
    message: /home is missing
```

### fail

Abort generation with a message (combine with `if`).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | yes |  | Error message |

```yaml
- if: flavor.name == 'archlinux' && args.legacy
  action: fail
  args:
    message: legacy mode is not supported on Arch
```

### log

Print a message when the step runs.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | yes |  | Message |
| `level` | string |  | `info` | info or warn One of: `info`, `warn`. |

```yaml
- action: log
  args:
    message: "Configuring ${{ args.user }}"
```

### reboot-required

Mark that a reboot is required (/var/run/reboot-required) and print a message (live systems only).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string |  | `a reboot is required to complete the configuration` | Message |

```yaml
- action: reboot-required
```

### wait-for

Wait until a TCP port is open, a path exists or a command succeeds (live systems only).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `port` | int |  |  | TCP port |
| `host` | string |  | `127.0.0.1` | Host for port checks |
| `path` | string |  |  | Path that must exist |
| `command` | string |  |  | Shell command that must succeed |
| `timeout` | int |  | `60` | Timeout in seconds |

```yaml
- action: wait-for
  args:
    port: 5432
    timeout: 30
```
